name: Spellgyre
description: Choose one -- Counter target spell. / Surveil 2, then draw two cards.
notes: First attempt found 2 serious bugs, both fixed: (1) translateEffectAsLeaf (Charm's own per-branch capture) assumed every choice branch produces exactly ONE root id -- Surveil's own correct 2-node source+emit shape (fixed earlier this batch) broke that assumption, silently dropping the ENTIRE Surveil branch from this real 2-mode Charm. Fixed by chaining extra sibling ids under the first captured one instead of requiring a single id. (2) Surveil's own handler never walked tree.children at all, so "Surveil 2, THEN DRAW TWO CARDS" (a chained SubAbility$) was silently dropped even outside a Charm context. Verified: the regenerated packet now shows {combine:1, of:[C,D]} with BOTH branches intact, D chaining through to a draw-2 node. In blb-success.json.
